limitations: No hosted PostgREST/WebSocket/multi-account or Storage service acceptance.
No physical IME/device/screen-reader speech/native Undo certification; automated composition events verified.
No financial/category/payment-group expansion, blank persisted creation, five-step Undo/Redo/history UI or production enablement.
Session draft/intent persistence is best effort when browser storage is available; capabilities are never persisted.
After reload, another document session cannot release the old session capability; expiry may be required before new writes.
findings: DB-confirmed canonical remains visible after failed snapshot and does not resend a successful Patch.
Submitted local revision and queued latest input are separate; one active transport per group, including timeout.
Dirty handoff flushes and freezes the leaving editor, releases exact capabilities, then reads fresh canonical for wildcard acquisition.
Unknown replay ledger persists request/origin/base/payload only; null token/epoch can replay an authorized existing result but cannot grant authority.
Initial real focus starts idle activity; snapshot/heartbeat/ACK do not. Idle refocus preserves first input/delete/paste intent.
